explanation: This snippet is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because it concatenates str(tag_num) directly into the SQL query string before calling self.query(q). An attacker supplying crafted input as tag_num could alter the WHERE clause to read unauthorized database records. The repair replaces concatenation with a '?' placeholder and passes tag_num separately to self.query, though complete safety cannot be verified without seeing self.query and because a bare scalar is passed instead of a parameter sequence.
